item.text:
In ResStock 2025 Release 1, the **Advanced Air Sealing** upgrade:

- **Eligible homes:** Existing dwelling units with baseline leakage **≥6 ACH50**, across all climate zones. New construction and units below 6 ACH50 are excluded.
- **Sealing target:** **5 ACH50**—five air changes per hour at a test pressure of 50 pascals.
- **Share covered:** **92.2% of existing dwelling units**; 7.8% are excluded.

Source: *ResStock Measure Documentation: Advanced Air Sealing*, Measure Summary and Tables 4–5, pp. 1 and 5. [Official report](https://docs.nlr.gov/docs/fy27osti/96738.pdf) · [Release-pinned text](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NatLabRockies/buildstock-corpus/resstock_amy2018_2025_release_1-v1/processed/resstock/resstock_amy2018_2025_release_1/upgrade_measures/measure_pdfs/96738.md).
